description: This file defines a service for aggregating hierarchical LLM (Large Language Model) costs from a MongoDB collection, including functions for projection, grouping, and formatting of cost data, as well as index management.

methods.name: projectionStage
methods.description: Creates a MongoDB aggregation projection stage to normalize and extract relevant fields from cost documents.

methods.name: addDateKeyStage
methods.description: Adds a date object to the aggregation pipeline, converting string dates to Date objects.

methods.name: projectDateKeyStage
methods.description: Projects the date as a formatted string and includes key fields for further grouping.

methods.name: groupByAgentDateStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, project, agent, and date, summing costs and tokens per day.

methods.name: groupAgentTotalsStage
methods.description: Aggregates data by agent, summing total costs and collecting costs and tokens by date.

methods.name: agentProjectStage
methods.description: Projects agent-level aggregated data, formatting costs and organizing tokens and costs by date.

methods.name: groupProjectStage
methods.description: Groups data by user and project, summing project costs and collecting agent data.

methods.name: projectProjectStage
methods.description: Projects project-level data, including total project cost and associated agents.

methods.name: groupUserStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, summing total user costs and collecting projects.

methods.name: finalProjectStage
methods.description: Projects the final user-level aggregate data, including total user cost and nested project info.

methods.name: aggregateHierarchy
methods.description: Main function to perform the aggregation pipeline and return formatted hierarchical cost data.

methods.name: ensureLlmCostsIndexes
methods.description: Creates indexes on the llm_costs collection to optimize query performance.
